thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PDR-4823 fired for inference-prod-queue — backlog > 95%, avg processing latency > 2.5s, autoscaler not keeping up (scale lag > 12m). Paging eng-oncall.

maya: acked the PD page, jumping in. seeing a steady tail of requests piling into queue-0. rl: autoscaler controller events show nodeProvisionDelay and scaleDownCooldowns suppressed.

raj: i'm on infra console — cloud API returning `QuotaExceeded` on GCE instances for this project; provisioning attempts are failing with 403 quota errors around vm-creation. hitting provider soft quota.

maya: ok that explains provisioning lag. how many unprocessed messages?

leah: ~23k items across hot partitions, backlog growing ~200/s. impact: low-latency inference requests timing out for a subset of customers, ~5% error rate rising. product team flagged one customer experiencing 502s.

maya: triage plan: 1) temporary throttle non-critical routes, 2) manual admission control -> reroute heavy jobs to a fallback model, 3) attempt manual node spin-up in other project/region if quota prevents this one. can one of you take on node spin-up?

raj: i'll try manual spin-up in backup-region eu-west3. running:
```
# create instances with minimal image/labels
gcloud compute instances create rwi-ot-spin-01 --zone=europe-west3-b --machine-type=n1-standard-16 --image-family=cos-stable --project=rwi-backup
```
If provider quota still blocks, fallback is to rehome some replicas to dedicated pool (dedicated-tenant).

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PDR-4823 acknowledged by maya. Escalation timer paused.

maya: i'm going to flip throttle rules for experimental/async routes to 10r/s per customer to relieve hotpath. applying policy now: `rbac-route-throttle: inference.async.* = 10rps`

leah: throttle is live — observed immediate drop in queue ingress on those routes. but hot real-time chat route still spiking.

raj: partial success — manual instance create returned `QuotaExceeded: CPUs per region` in primary project, but backup project allowed creation. spun up 4 nodes in eu-west3, registered with cluster via bootstrap; kube shows new nodes Ready in ~3m.

maya: scaling groups updated to add 4 nodes, starting additional pods. running `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep backlog` — pods are starting and pulling KV cache sync.

leah: consumer concurrency catching up, backlog decreasing from 23k -> 12k over 14 minutes. error rate trending down from 5.1% -> 1.4%.

pagerduty: PDR-4823 — incident acknowledged, responders: maya, raj, leah. next oncall: ops-rotations scheduled handoff at 1750003600 UTC.

maya: quick customer-impact note for status page: "We experienced elevated inference latencies and limited errors due to capacity provisioning delays. Mitigation: manual capacity added and traffic throttled; most customers restored. Root cause: cloud CPU regional quota exhaustion causing autoscaler failures." I'll draft short message and ping comms.

leah: logs show autoscaler controller ignored pending scale-up because node requests queued against a taint-based placement rule that mismatched image labels. adding a temporary toleration allowed the scheduler to place new pods on the manual nodes. I'll raise a follow-up ticket for autoscaler gating checks.

maya: handing off to ops-rotations for post-incident cleanup and follow-ups. ops-rotations please confirm you'll take the follow-up and timeline for quota request with cloud provider.

ops-rotations: on it. I'll file the support case with cloud provider, request quota bump and expedite. will coordinate with finance for limit adjustments; ETA for quota resolution unknown but we have temporary capacity from backup project. will run a postmortem doc and include remediation: (1) autoscaler preflight to detect quota shortfall, (2) cross-project fallback automation, (3) alert refinement to separate quota vs runtime saturation.

maya: thanks — closing PD now. will keep thread open for notes and the postmortem link. :white_check_mark:
